faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about Seedance 2 Free

items.question: Is Seedance video generation really free to try?
items.answer: New users receive free trial credits that can be used to generate videos. Each generation consumes credits, and you can top up or subscribe when you need more.

items.question: What can I create with Seedance 2?
items.answer: Seedance 2 supports text-to-video and image-to-video workflows with synchronized audio, making it suitable for short social clips, product teasers, and creative storytelling.

items.question: How long does a generation take?
items.answer: Most short videos finish within one to three minutes depending on duration, resolution, and current service load. The result area shows live progress while you wait.

items.question: Do the generated videos include audio?
items.answer: Yes. Seedance 2 generates videos with synchronized audio by default, and you can adjust audio-related options before generating.

items.question: Can I use the generated videos commercially?
items.answer: Generated videos can be used for your creative projects. Please review the content policy and applicable laws before commercial distribution.

items.question: Which model does this page use?
items.answer: This experience page defaults to the fast lightweight Seedance model so you can try generation quickly. Advanced Seedance models are available to subscribers in the full generator.
